mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_info ( session_count, start_time, end_time, status ) VALUES ( #{sessionCount,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_count, start_time, end_time, status, created_at, updated_at FROM session_info ORDER BY session_count ASC
SELECT id, session_count, start_time, end_time, status, created_at, updated_at FROM session_info WHERE status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1

SELECT session_count as reception_count, start_time as min_time, end_time as max_time, CASE WHEN end_time IS NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' ~ 进行中') ELSE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) END as time_range_display FROM session_info ORDER BY session_count ASC

SELECT session_count as reception_count, start_time as min_time, end_time as max_time, CASE WHEN end_time IS NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' ~ 进行中') ELSE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) END as time_range_display FROM session_info WHERE session_count = #{sessionCount,jdbcType=BIGINT}
